key_insight: Segmentation-guided direct regression estimates rooftop PV capacity more accurately than forcing predictions to equal mask-derived area times power density.
engineering_relevance: Aerial-image capacity estimates could help distribution planners fill gaps in installation-level PV inventories when interconnection records are incomplete.
method: Retain U-Net segmentation to identify PV regions.
Use soft-mask pooling to extract PV-region features and area descriptors.
Directly regress nonnegative capacity rather than an area–density product.
evidence_signal: Across three independent runs on 7,590 French rooftop installations, Direct Head reduced MAE by 8.7% and 12.5% and symmetric MAPE by 14.0% and 20.7% versus a parameter-matched area-density neural model under the original split and department-based holdout, respectively.
watch_item: Generalization beyond French rooftop installations and across different aerial-imagery conditions remains unestablished by the reported evaluation.
paper_title: Segmentation-Guided Direct Capacity Estimation of Rooftop Photovoltaics from Aerial Imagery
